dialogue_texts: Oh, My Majesty, thank you so...
A maid shouldn't offer gratitude while looking at the floor. It's unsightly.
Your intervention knocked the curse out of me.
It was less about knocking out and more about deep cleaning. That glohm was an insult to my eyes.
So, the interior decorator finally shows her face.
I hope you have a receipt for this peace you've been selling; I'd like a full refund.
You're useless now, Fusana. And so is that pathetic lunarian empress there...
Please deal with her, My Majesty.
Time for me to finish both of you.
I've lived through more eternities than you have breaths, fool.
The Federal Kingdom of Gensokyo is mine.
The Order is about to face a very messy eviction.
You will be destroyed after you found a way to rid the glohm from her.
I have seen the rise and fall of a thousand "new worlds."
I can assure yours won't last the night.
You will be destroyed, your remains will be used to build something new, and that soul will destroy all of Gensokyo.
